verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document project-level roles or granular view/edit permissions for GitHub Projects. The only related items are an API flag to make a project public, which is a coarse visibility toggle rather than granular role assignment, and API token types, which are authentication rather than access roles. Neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
